This is a classic presentation of painless obstructive jaundice with systemic symptoms (fatigue, weight loss), physical signs (icterus), and lab/imaging findings highly suggestive of **malignant biliary obstruction**. The triad of:

- Palpable (or ultrasound-documented) enlarged, thin-walled gallbladder (Courvoisier sign),
